## Read-only mirror notice

Thanks for taking the time to contribute.

This GitHub repository is a **read-only mirror** of the private GitLab source of truth. Pull requests opened on GitHub cannot be merged and are overwritten by mirror sync.

## How to contribute code

- Send your patch to `security@mirastacklabs.ai`, or
- Open a merge request on the public GitLab project when that path is announced.

## Issues

GitHub issues are welcome and are reviewed.
